name: redstart-yellowscript
description: Coding agent for a local Redstart Nest — zero-config discovery, Redstart login, workspace-aware tools.

commands.title: Show the Chat Waiting for You

redstartYellowscript.serverUrl.markdownDescription: Explicit Nest gateway URL (e.g. `http://192.168.1.20:19080`). When set, discovery is skipped entirely. Leave empty to find the Nest automatically via its beacon.

redstartYellowscript.discovery.enabled.description: Scan the local network for a running Redstart Nest on connect.

redstartYellowscript.discovery.timeoutMs.description: Per-host timeout for the beacon probe. Raise this on a slow or congested network.

redstartYellowscript.autoConnect.description: Try to reconnect to the last known Nest when a window opens.

redstartYellowscript.agent.maxTurns.markdownDescription: Model round trips one message may run before Yellowscript asks whether to keep going. **Continue** grants as many again. A repeated identical tool call is stopped sooner, whatever this says.

redstartYellowscript.notifyWhenWaiting.markdownDescription: When the window is not focused, show a notification when a chat starts waiting for you (an approval, a question, the turn limit) or a run of over two minutes finishes. The status bar shows a bell while any chat waits.

redstartYellowscript.tools.unifiedDiff.markdownDescription: Offer the model `ys_edit_file`, which edits with a unified diff. Off by default: small models get diffs wrong, and `ys_replace` covers the same edits. Takes effect in a new window.

redstartYellowscript.commands.builtInSaf.markdownDescription: Run read-only commands without asking: listing and reading workspace files (`ls`, `cat`, `type`), searching (`grep`, `rg`), versions, package facts (`npm ls`), read-only git (`git status`, `git diff`, `git log`), and `tsc --noEmit`. A line that chains, pipes, redirects, expands a variable, or reaches outside the workspace or into a secrets file always asks.

redstartYellowscript.commands.autoRunPro.markdownDescription: Run the project's own checks without asking: its `test`, `build`, `lint`, `typecheck`, `check` and `format:check` scripts, a dev server (`dev`, `start`, `serve`, `preview`) in the background, and locally installed `vitest run`, `jest`, `eslint`, `prettier --check`, `playwright test`, `pytest`, `ruff check`, `mypy`, `cargo` and `go` checks. They run the workspace's code; a script this run changed asks.

redstartYellowscript.extraReadRoots.markdownDescription: Folders outside the workspace that the read tools and read-only commands may read (never write). Added by **Always for this folder** when the model asks to read outside the workspace.

redstartYellowscript.allowedCommands.markdownDescription: Command prefixes that run without asking in this workspace, e.g. `npm test` or `npx tsc`. A line that chains, pipes or redirects (`&&`, `|`, `;`, `>`) always asks. Added by the **Always allow** button on a command prompt.

redstartYellowscript.approvedWriteTools.description: Write tools the user has chosen to always allow in this workspace.

redstartYellowscript.editorButton.markdownDescription: Show the Yellowscript button in the editor title bar, which opens a new chat in an editor tab.

scripts.check: node scripts/sync-agent-core.mjs --check && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.package: npm run check && npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies
